verdict.rationale: Windows is an operating system, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server that agents can connect to is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP. The AI items (Copilot in Microsoft apps, Windows AI Foundry toolkit, Windows AI APIs for Copilot+ PCs) and the PowerShell CLI probe are adjacent features that earn no credit toward an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
